title: Micropsychism needs a deflationary view of human experience

statements.text: Human consciousness is not an aspect of any micro-level consciousness, so micropsychism must ground it by truthmaking, which makes human minds mere shadows cast by the structure of discourse, as parties are. That is implausible once analytic functionalism is rejected, and the panpsychist has rejected it.

sources.quote: I believe that micropsychism is, whilst cosmopsychism is not, reliant on a deflationary account of facts concerning human and animal experience
Micropsychism so construed is not a very plausible view.
